creator: opichillc
title: Claude Code now falls back to AGENTS.md when no CLAUDE.md exists, so cross-tool projects can keep one instructions file and cloned repos with AGENTS.md work natively

tools.name: AGENTS.md
tools.detail: Generic agent-instructions file read by 'just about every other AI coding tool'; Claude Code now reads it if no CLAUDE.md is present

tools.name: CLAUDE.md
tools.detail: Claude Code's native instructions file; can be archived if you migrate to AGENTS.md

tools.name: Symlink workaround
tools.detail: Old method: symlink CLAUDE.md to AGENTS.md or add a 'read the other file' note

claims: Anthropic added support for AGENTS.md: Claude checks for agents.md if there is no Claude.md
If you maintain both, you can migrate everything to AGENTS.md and archive CLAUDE.md for a single source of truth
Cloned repos that ship an AGENTS.md no longer need to be wired to a CLAUDE.md
Net effect for most users: 'not very much'; keeping both is harmless
how_to_steps: If you use multiple AI coding tools, consolidate instructions into AGENTS.md
Remove or archive CLAUDE.md (Claude Code will read AGENTS.md only when CLAUDE.md is absent)
For cloned repos with AGENTS.md, do nothing -- Claude Code picks it up natively
Or keep both files if you prefer
on_screen_only: Karaoke captions only ('AND HERE'S WHAT', 'FOR THE AGENTS.MD', 'CLAUDE.MD.', 'FROM SOMEBODY ELSE'S', 'LET ME KNOW'); creator Courtney on camera, no screen content
cta: Like/follow; comment whether you will switch to AGENTS.md exclusively

relevance.why: Haji runs Claude Code alongside Codex at times (per liked content); knowing the fallback rule avoids duplicate instruction files and makes third-party repos with AGENTS.md work without setup.

implement_score.why: Low effort, low impact: for Claude-first projects keep CLAUDE.md (it takes precedence and supports Claude-specific features like imports); only consolidate to AGENTS.md on repos shared with Codex/Cursor users. Check the precedence rule first.

verify: Confirm in the Claude Code changelog: is AGENTS.md read only when CLAUDE.md is absent, or always/alongside? Does it apply to nested directories and ~/.claude?
Do CLAUDE.md-only features (@file imports, /memory, auto-memory) work from AGENTS.md?
Which Claude Code version introduced it

gap.what: New small fact: Claude Code's AGENTS.md fallback and the migrate-or-keep-both decision; liked set has CLAUDE.md-thinning advice but nothing on AGENTS.md interoperability.
